title: feat(types)!: declare the spec's axis config on ObjectChartSchema.xAxis / yAxis (objectui#10518)
body:
Fixes #10518
Clause-②: yes

`ObjectChartSchema.xAxis` and `ObjectChartSchema.yAxis` now declare `@objectstack/spec`'s axis config **by reference**, on both faces. `xAxis` is ONE `ChartAxisSchema` object and `yAxis` is a list of them. This follows ruling `5809510046`, branch 2 (declare), which triage `5829725284` reused for this card, and mirrors PR objectui#10511 on `ChartSchema`. For `xAxis` it follows the seat decision on the first round's `needs_decision` (comment `5831464172`, option A): the object only, with no string arm and no fold. No renderer changed.

Implemented by the `os-dev` that seat `domain:ui#2` dispatched (claim `5830527047`, amended by that decision), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. There were five rounds: `yAxis`, the `xAxis` patch, then three changeset-prose rounds.

## 1. Protocol first: the spec declares both keys on this node

Read from the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, which `pnpm-lock.yaml` pins:

- In the `REACT_BLOCKS` entry for the `ObjectChart` react block, `schemaType` is `'object-chart'`, `schema` is `ChartConfigSchema` itself (checked by identity), and `dataProps` includes `xAxis` and `yAxis`.
- `ChartConfigSchema.xAxis` is ONE `ChartAxisSchema` with no string arm; a bare string and a list are both refused at `xAxis`. `ChartConfigSchema.yAxis` is an ARRAY of them. `ChartAxisSchema` is a strict object with nine keys, `field` required, and a `.default()` on `showGridLines` and on `logarithmic`.
- The metadata tier has no `ComponentPropsMap['object-chart']` entry. The spec skips that entry on purpose and says so in `component.zod.ts`.

So a mirror that declares the spec's shapes is the protocol's own contract. It is not new vocabulary.

## 2. H1: reach path, measured with the real registry (one-time probe, not committed)

The probe rendered `SchemaRenderer`, the real registry, `ObjectChartBlock`, `ElementDataSourceGate`, `ObjectChart`, `ChartRenderer` and `normalizeChartSchema`. Only `AdvancedChartImpl` was a double, and it recorded its props. Base was `a50600166`.

| probe | node | what `AdvancedChartImpl` received |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | the showcase producer's node, verbatim (`properties` bag, dataset-bound) | `yAxes: [{ field: 'task_count', stepSize: 1 }]` |
| P1 control | the same node without `yAxis` | no `yAxes` |
| P2 | all nine spec keys on one `yAxis` entry | all nine keys on `yAxes[0]` |
| P3 | all nine spec keys on `xAxis` | all nine keys on `xAxis` |
| P4 | the showcase `renewals-pipeline` react shape (`objectName` + `aggregate` + `xAxis: { field }` + `yAxis: [{ field, format }]`) | `yAxes: [{ field: 'total', format: '$0,0' }]`, `xAxisKey: 'status'` |

Render leg, with no leaf double: the showcase node drew its y ticks as `0 1 2 3 4 5` with its `yAxis`, and as `0 2 4 6 8` without it. The node forwards the axis config, and the renderer acts on it.

## 3. Per-key liveness read on `object-chart` carriers, with lit controls

The scanner finds every `xAxis` / `yAxis` whose value is an object or a list. It reads the axis-level keys and attributes each hit to its carrier: an enclosing node's `type`, or the enclosing JSX tag. The file population comes from `git ls-tree` of the same ref the reads use. Bare-string values were scanned separately.

| repo at ref | files | axis-object hits | control `xAxisKey:` | files naming an `object-chart` carrier | hits on an `object-chart` carrier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack `a08e059` | 9435 | 58 | 5 | 56 | 14: showcase `command-center` metadata page `yAxis [{ field, stepSize }]`; showcase `renewals-pipeline` react page `xAxis { field }` and `yAxis [{ field, format }]`; the rest are docs (`react-pages.mdx`, `validating-metadata.mdx`), the `objectstack-ui` skill and its eval, and lint tests |
| objectui `a50600166` | 8561 | 89 | 141 | 58 | 0 authored. The one attributed hit is prose in this node's own docblock. Tests use `xAxis { field }` in the objectui#8168 render pin. `examples/`, `content/`, `apps/` and `packages/types/examples` have 0, and their `chartType` controls light (2 / 11 / 3 / 1) |
| hotcrm `4db37cd` | 849 | 18 | 0 | 0 | 0 (all 18 hits sit in a dashboard widget `chartConfig`, a different carrier) |
| cloud | not reachable | | | | `git ls-remote` asks for credentials |

Designer `inputs` for the `object-chart` registration: `objectName`, `data`, `filter`, `aggregate`, `drillDown`. There is no axis input; the `aggregate` input is the control.

| key | real producer on an `object-chart` node |
|---|---|
| `field` | showcase `command-center` (metadata, `yAxis`) and `renewals-pipeline` (react, `xAxis` and `yAxis`) |
| `stepSize` | showcase `command-center` (`yAxis`) |
| `format` | showcase `renewals-pipeline` (`yAxis`) |
| `title`, `min`, `max`, `showGridLines`, `position`, `logarithmic` | no authored document in the three reachable repos |

The six unwritten keys are declared as well. The spec declares all nine on this node's react block (section 1). The node's renderer reads all nine (probes P2 and P3). The dispatch fixes the binding as the spec schema by reference, with no hand-written subset. objectui#10511 closed the retire branch on the same grounds.

The non-spec shapes this PR now refuses on an `object-chart` carrier are a bare-string or list `xAxis` and a single-object or bare-string `yAxis`. None appears in any of the three repos. The nearby bare-string hits are all report charts (`ReportChartSchema`). The one bare-string `xAxis` written against this type is the objectui#8168 renderer-tolerance fixture (section 4).

## 4. The change

- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, `xAxis`: `z.union([stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartAxisSchema), z.never()], { error })`. The `z.never()` arm admits nothing and adds nothing to the inferred type. It exists because zod runs a one-option union as its option, so a single-arm union's error hook never fires. Every refusal is one `invalid_union` at `xAxis`, the shape `ChartSchema.xAxis` already reports. A malformed object gets the axis arm's own issues, with their paths and in the spec's words, including its alias hint. A bare column name, a list or any other non-object gets the remedy `xAxis: { field: 'status' }`. ⛔ There is no string arm and no fold onto `xAxisKey`: objectui#7113's alias stays scoped to `ChartSchema`.
- The same file, `yAxis`: `z.array(stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartAxisSchema))`. A non-list gets a remedy message, and an issue inside an entry keeps its own path and the spec's wording.
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the TS twin, `xAxis?: SpecChartAxis` and `yAxis?: SpecChartAxis[]`, typed with the spec's `ChartAxis`. The `xAxisKey` member doc now points at `xAxis`. The interface docblock records that neither census pin sees these two keys (see H4).
- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.absentCategoryAxisRefusal-8168.test.tsx`: ONE line, the surface extension the seat granted. The leg "a bare string `xAxis`, the report surface spelling" pins the renderer's tolerance, and `normalizeChartSchema` is unchanged. Its value now reads `'stage' as unknown as ObjectChartSchema['xAxis']`, the cast idiom that file's `UNAUTHORABLE` helper already applies to `aggregate`. The leg still pins the renderer, and the type no longer admits the shape. Reverse check: with the cast removed, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in plugin-charts fails with TS2322 on that line.
- Boundary ledgers: the entries already cover this crossing (`ChartAxisSchema` is in `IMPORTED` since objectui#7690, and `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema` is in `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS`). Their ground comments now name objectui#10518 and both keys, and the pair's comment reads six spec crossings over five spec symbols. Membership is unchanged.
- Changeset `.changeset/10518-object-chart-y-axis-declared.md`: `@object-ui/types` **minor**, naming every document shape that now refuses on either key, and stating only what holds for every chart type; see section 6. The file name is kept from round one, and the frontmatter is byte-identical (md5 `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6` before and after the body edits).

## 5. Pin, red on the base and green on the head

`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-chart-axis-config-10518.test.ts` has 39 tests:

- `yAxis`, blocks (a) to (e): the spec side read off the installed spec; the key in the mirror's own shape; every spec key accepted and kept; omitted defaults staying omitted (CONTROL: the raw spec schema injects them); the LIT CONTROL, the showcase `command-center` node flattened the way `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties`; four entry refusals by `code` + `path`, each message equal to the spec's own; the refusal at `safeValidateSchema`, the door `objectui validate` / `objectui check` run; a single object or bare name refused with `invalid_type`; and the TS twin through `@ts-expect-error` rows plus an `Equal` type pin.
- `xAxis`, blocks (f) to (j): the spec's one-object arm read off the spec, where a string and a list are refused at `xAxis`; the key in the mirror's own shape; every spec key accepted and kept; omitted defaults staying omitted; the object NOT folded, so no `xAxisKey` is minted; the LIT CONTROL, the showcase `renewals-pipeline` axes (`xAxis: { field }`, `yAxis: [{ field, format }]`, with its `objectName` + `aggregate`), which parse on the mirror and through `safeValidateSchema`; four in-object refusals (`min: 'zero'`, `position: 'middle'`, `grid`, a missing `field`), each `invalid_union` at `xAxis` carrying the spec's own message; the door; a bare name, a list and a number, each refused naming the `{ field }` remedy (a malformed object is NOT told the remedy); and the TS twin through four `@ts-expect-error` rows plus an `Equal` type pin.

Every mutation committed the fix first, restored from `HEAD` by absolute path under a trap, and proved the restore by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import the mirror from source, so no `dist/` is on the path.

- **Round 1, mutation 1** (`yAxis` only, at `74cf402ed`): both source faces reset to the base blobs `efe2595f` / `2176166f`. Observed 8 failed | 11 passed (19), plus TS2344 x1 and TS2578 x4, as predicted.
- **Round 1, mutation 2**: only the TS `yAxis` member deleted. vitest stayed at 19 passed. `tsc` gave the 5 errors above plus the parity ratchet's TS2322 naming `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema` and `yAxis`.
- **Round 2, mutation 3** (both keys, at `0b1b1c816`): both faces reset to the base blobs; on disk, all four declaration counts went from 1 to 0. Predicted 19 failed / 20 passed, TS2344 x2 and TS2578 x8. Observed **19 failed | 20 passed (39)**. The 19 are the 8 `yAxis` refusals and shape pin, plus the `xAxis` shape pin, four in-object refusals, the door, three remedy refusals, the door for the bare string, and the CONTROL that a malformed object is refused. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exited 2 with exactly TS2344 x2 and TS2578 x8. Restored: blobs `51ad74bf` / `3dcbc78f` match `HEAD`.
- **Round 2, mutation 4**: only the TS member `xAxis?: SpecChartAxis;` deleted. The first attempt was a no-op: a quoting slip left the anchor unmatched, the on-disk count stayed 1, and that reading was voided and rerun. The script now aborts when the mutation does not land. On the rerun the count went from 1 to 0 (blob `d80951ba`). vitest stayed at 39 passed. `tsc` exited 2 with TS2344 x1 and TS2578 x4 in the pin, plus the parity ratchet's TS2322 naming `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema` and `xAxis`. Restored and verified the same way.

## 6. Gates, at `a6e5c6d77` (the merge of main into the branch) unless noted

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ examples/schema-catalog/test/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/`, plus the three cli validate/check suites and `unfulfilled-chart-stubs-8760`, from the repo root: **360 files / 8501 tests passed**. At `0b1b1c816`, before the merge, the same set gave 359 / 8500.
- Census pins, ledgers and the fixture file, run on their own at `0b1b1c816`: `object-chart-undeclared-keys-8885`, `widget-schema-anchors-7946`, `zod-mirror-parity`, `imported-defaults-8317` and `ObjectChart.absentCategoryAxisRefusal-8168` gave **5 files / 208 tests passed**, including "a bare string `xAxis`, the report surface spelling".
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (tsc, examples, tests): exit 0.
- Consumer direction, downstream: `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, the package whose published `ObjectChartProps.schema` is this type. Its dependency closure was built first (types, core, i18n, react, components, sdui-parser, data-objectstack, react-runtime). The rebuilt `dist/objectql.d.ts` carries both members. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` exited 0. The round-1 reverse check still stands: a scratch plugin-charts file typed `yAxis: { field: 'n' }` got TS2353. No other consumer writes `xAxis` or `yAxis` on an `ObjectChart`-typed value, per a grep of every file that names `ObjectChartSchema`, `ObjectChartProps` or the `ObjectChart` component.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 1 changeset for 6 source files in 2 released packages (the second is the plugin-charts test file). `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite`: green; `check-changeset-fixed` was green at `0b1b1c816`. `check:changeset-claims`, report-only, was run at `0b1b1c816`: the same 38 pending changesets as round 1, none naming the fixture file. The object-chart ones (objectui#8168, #8885, #7946) were read, and none is falsified. `check:pending-changeset-literals`: green.
- `check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. `check:control-bytes` and `check-type-check-coverage`: green. At `0b1b1c816`: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:unreferenced-sources` green, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the diff NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint over the six touched source and test files (`--no-inline-config --format json`, at `0b1b1c816`): 0 errors. Per rule, base against head on the five edited files is unchanged: `no-explicit-any` is 34 to 34 in `objectql.ts`, 1 to 1 in `objectql.zod.ts`, 2 to 2 in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, 0 to 0 in `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`, and 3 to 3 in the 8168 test. The new pin has 1 warning, from the `Equal OF any` can-fail control that it copies from `object-chart-undeclared-keys-8885.test.ts`; warnings are not gated. Each file is in ESLint's own population. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so this diff cannot move another file's verdict.
- Main and sibling branches: main moved in `objectql.ts` (objectui#8932's kanban docblock, a distant range, landed as PR objectui#10588), so main was merged in as a merge commit, with no rebase and no force-push. After the merge, `git merge-tree --write-tree` against the newest `origin/main` (`adeecd666`) and against PR objectui#10595's branch (`882c5e13e`) is clean both times. At that point, main's later commits (through `adeecd666`) touched none of this diff's files.
- **Rounds 3 and 4, changeset prose only.** Round 3 (`0e710207d`) measured each listed shape through the real `object-chart` path, whose runtime is byte-identical to base `f169a030a`. That round also corrected one `objectql.zod.ts` comment: a list `xAxis` is not a normalizer tolerance. Contract-review round 2 (record `5832703331`) then showed that whether a no-category or no-field shape draws depends on the chart type and on the rows' columns (a `name` column, the `value` fallback), extending round 1's finding (record `5832280197`) that not every refused shape draws a chart. The changeset therefore names only what holds everywhere.
- **Round 4, at `5367bc102`.** The lead-in now says that several of the now-refused documents draw a chart today, and that what the rest draw depends on the chart type, on the rows and on the node's other category and series sources. The bullets keep only these equivalences:
  - a malformed `min` / `position`, or an undeclared `grid` / `logScale`, changes nothing that is drawn;
  - a bare-string `xAxis` draws what `{ field }` draws;
  - a list, a non-object or an object with no `field` names no category;
  - a `yAxis` entry or a single `yAxis` object with no `field` adds no series.
  They were measured on the published `normalizeChartSchema` and by rendering 11 chart types against 2 row sets, one of which carries a `name` column. The frontmatter md5 is still `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6`. Gates at `5367bc102`: `check-changeset-presence` ✅, `check-changeset-no-major` ✅, `check:new-line-citations` `VERDICT … 0 new citation(s)`, `check:control-bytes` ✅, and `check-changeset-claims` report-only exit 0. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against `origin/main` `e0f820246` is clean.
- **Round 5, at `b2936fc66`, prose only.** Contract-review round 3 found one clause false: the lead-in credited the `minor` level to what the refused documents draw. The lead-in now gives the reason the version policy reads, which is the narrowed accept set: breaking semantics, which this repo ships as `minor`. Nothing else changed, and the frontmatter md5 is still `ecedb10c5189b2c8841ea736b67c3cc6`.

## 7. H4 and H6

- **H4, census pins:** `object-chart-undeclared-keys-8885` and `widget-schema-anchors-7946` count `schema.KEY` reads in `ObjectChart.tsx`. The census regex returns 16 reads for that file, and neither `xAxis` nor `yAxis` is among them: the component forwards both by spreading the node. Neither key sat in either ledger, so nothing moved. Both pins pass at the head.
- **H6, docs:** `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` has no `ObjectChartSchema` row set, and `plugin-charts.mdx` has no `object-chart` section. PR objectui#10571 is on main, but this PR needs neither page, and neither was touched.

## Acceptance notes

- `xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` / `aggregation` are declared on this node and not read there (a one-time probe; seat filing). A static-data `object-chart` with only `xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` reached `AdvancedChartImpl` with no `xAxisKey` and no series. An `objectName` node with `xAxisField` and no `aggregate` drew the objectui#8168 refusal (`chart-missing-category-axis`, `role="alert"`), and `AdvancedChartImpl` was never called. The seat filed it as objectui#10608, for its own ruling. Neither key was retired or changed here (H5).
- The two census pins cannot see a key forwarded by spreading the node. They read `schema.KEY` only, and AGENTS.md's "a source grep's zero cannot answer this" rule applies. These keys needed the render probe. That is an observation; no card is proposed.
- The mirror judges the flattened node. A metadata page's `properties` bag is not a `BaseSchema` member, so `safeValidateSchema` on the unhoisted envelope does not reach `properties.xAxis` / `properties.yAxis`. The pins judge the hoisted shape and say so.
- The `renewals-pipeline` react node as a whole is not this mirror's vocabulary: the react wrapper parks its `type` as `specType`, and its `series` uses the spec's `{ name }` arm. The lit control therefore judges that producer's axis props and binding on a node with `chartType`. That is outside this card.
- Context, not a defect: spec `main` tombstones `xAxis` / `yAxis` on the dataset-bound dashboard WIDGET's `chartConfig` for the next major. Those tombstones are scoped to that carrier, and they say the base `ChartConfigSchema` that the `ObjectChart` react block publishes keeps both keys.

Liveness reads, probes and ablations are one-time proofs. Nothing in this PR re-derives them except the pins above.
